It simply read: \"If you find this, you are not alone.\" Tomas stood there a long while, the wind tugging at his coat, before tucking the note into his pocket and climbing back up to light the lamp.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市，像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，光晕里飘着薄薄的雾气，空气里带着一点凉意和尘土的味道。偶尔有一辆清洁车缓缓驶过，刷子摩擦地面的声音格外清晰。便利店的灯光是唯一还醒着的角落，玻璃门里映出孤独的身影。远处偶尔传来几声狗吠，又很快消失在寂静里。高楼的窗户大多是黑的，只有极少几户还亮着灯，像是夜班归来的人，或是失眠的灵魂。天边微微泛起一点灰蓝色，城市还没醒，却已经开始呼吸。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling a smaller version of itself.\nImagine Russian nesting dolls: you keep opening smaller dolls until you reach the tiniest one that doesn't open anymore.\nThat tiniest doll is called the 'base case,' and it's what stops the function from calling itself forever."}
